findings.summary: Cube bottom (z=0.120 m) is below the divider top (0.150 m) at transit start; first penetration at t=4.1 s.
Contact persists for more than 5 control steps, then plan_transit stalls instead of re-planning.
Raising transit_height to 0.26 m clears the divider with 6 cm margin across ±30 mm divider offsets.
Env 1 and Env 2 both see the failure vanish when cube z > 0.175 m during transit; clearance, not speed, is the cause.
Lifting above 0.30 m hits joint 4 lower limit for target_y > 0.22 m.
Slowing the approach to 70% reduces penetration depth but times out on far-target cases.
Grasp offset is stable (±1.2 mm) across seeds 1042–1047; grasp drift is ruled out.
Gripper opens 0.12 s before the cube settles; release timing looks early at high transit speed.

candidates.rationale: Raise transit height from 0.15 m to 0.26 m so the carried cube clears the divider with margin.
Raise transit height to 0.22 m and slow the approach to 70% speed.
